company_name: Avax One Technology Ltd. Common Shares
title: AVAX One Announces Financial Leadership Change
body_markdown: **WEST PALM BEACH, FL, Aug. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —** AVAX One Technology Ltd. (Nasdaq: AVX) (“AVAX One” or the “Company”), today announced the departure of Chief Financial Officer (“CFO”) Chris Polimeni, effective August 17, 2026. Stephanie Brady, the Company’s Controller, has been promoted to Chief Accounting Officer and will oversee the Company’s financial reporting function.
